plan.summary: FEATURE C: add a periodic, route-scoped, staleness-gated stranded-'sending' recovery to MessageSenderService so a cxapi row leased ('sending') but never POSTed (claimed→crash mid-run, no restart) is reset to 'queued' WITHOUT waiting for a service restart. Complements the e62ce0e8 worker-wedge fix (which made the periodic 'posting'→'ambiguous' sweep restart-free) and closes the gap exposed by the 2026-06-12 second incident where 3 messages stranded in 'sending' (attempt_count=0) after a mid-dispatch JWT-crash restart.
plan.q_intent: FEATURE C — recovery sweep 'sending' kapsamı (2026-06-12 ikinci incident'tan): MessageSenderService.TryRecoverStrandedAsync'e route-scoped + staleness-gated stale-'sending' reset ekle (şu an yalnız 'posting'→'ambiguous' periyodik kurtarılıyor; 'sending' reset STARTUP-only → restart-ortası strand'lar restart'a kadar öksüz kalıyor).
plan.interview_notes: AskUserQuestion 2/2 gri nokta (2026-06-12): (1) STALENESS ANCHOR = Q 'yeni claimed_at kolonu (migration)' seçti — dequeue claim 'sending' yaparken hiçbir timestamp damgalamıyordu; last_attempt_at yeniden-kullanım yerine temiz semantikli ayrı claimed_at TIMESTAMPTZ kolonu (last_attempt_at saf 'son POST denemesi' kalır). (2) StaleSendingMinutes = Q '3 dk' seçti (posting=5'ten ayrı; 'sending' pre-POST + duplicate-safe olduğundan düşük eşik güvenli, strand'ı daha hızlı kurtarır). KARARLAR (planlama): (a) 'sending'→'queued' broadcast counter DEĞİŞTİRMEZ — claim broadcast.queued'ı azaltmıyor (DequeueMessagesAsync sadece status set ediyor), yani 'queued'/'sending'/'posting' hepsi broadcast.queued (non-terminal) sayılıyor → reset counter-neutral, posting sweep'in CTE/completion'ı GEREKMEZ. (b) route-scoped (send_route='wapcrm_cxapi') — startup reset ile tutarlı, bridge'e dokunmaz. (c) startup ResetStrandedCxapiSendingAsync (ungated, tüm 'sending') AYNEN kalır — boot'ta live send yok, gate gereksiz. (d) periyodik sweep mevcut RecoverySweepIntervalMs (2dk) throttle'ı paylaşır, _isProcessing guard içinde (send'lerle serialize). (e) partial index idx_outbound_messages_cxapi_sending (idx_..._queued precedent'i) periyodik sweep'in full-table-scan'ini önler. (f) INV-OB-096 = sending-recovery domain marker (kendi try/catch'i, 065 ambiguous/posting domain'iyle karışmasın).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Migration 064-cxapi-stranded-sending-recovery.sql: additive + idempotent — (a) ALTER TABLE outbound_messages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS claimed_at TIMESTAMPTZ; (b) CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbound_messages_cxapi_sending ON outbound_messages (claimed_at) WHERE send_route='wapcrm_cxapi' AND status='sending'; (c) DO $verify$ INV-SEED-064 fails loud if claimed_at column absent; (d) canonical arch/db/outbound.sql synced (claimed_at column + index). No CHECK-constraint change.

DequeueMessagesAsync claim UPDATE stamps claimed_at = NOW() alongside status='sending' (hot-path, additive — claim-time anchor for staleness). No other dequeue behaviour changes; claimed_at NOT added to RETURNING.

New OutboundRepository.SweepStrandedSendingAsync(int staleSendingMinutes) resets cxapi 'sending'→'queued' WHERE send_route='wapcrm_cxapi' AND status='sending' AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at < NOW() - make_interval(mins => @mins) (parameterized, no string interpolation), returns affected row count. No broadcast counter touch.

CxapiSendOptions.StaleSendingMinutes (default 3) added; MessageSenderService.TryRecoverStrandedAsync calls the sending sweep inside the existing throttle + _isProcessing guard, in its own try/catch(NpgsqlException)→INV-OB-096, logging a SystemWarn with the reset count when >0. INV-OB-096 registered in ErrorCodes.cs + errors.md. Full solution builds clean.

verification_questions.question: Is the periodic 'sending'→'queued' reset duplicate-safe — can a message that was already POSTed to cxapi ever be reset and re-sent, causing a double delivery?
Can the staleness-gated periodic sweep race a legitimately in-flight send and wrongly reset a row that is about to be POSTed within the current dispatch cycle?

Does resetting 'sending'→'queued' keep the per-broadcast counters consistent (no double-count, no orphaned non-terminal counter), and is migration 064 additive/idempotent with the canonical outbound.sql kept in sync?

forbidden_areas: MainAppCallbackClient / bridge path (mainapp_bridge rows must never be touched — route-scoped to wapcrm_cxapi only)
SweepStrandedPostingAsync 'posting'→'ambiguous' logic and its broadcast-completion CTE (unchanged)
Startup ResetStrandedCxapiSendingAsync (ungated all-'sending' reset stays as-is)
SetMessagePostingAsync CAS and the send/outcome path
chk_message_status CHECK constraint (no new status value — 'sending' and 'queued' already exist)
non_goals: No new message status value (reuses existing 'sending'/'queued')
No broadcast counter / completion change for the sending reset (counter-neutral)
No unit tests (DB-bound repo SQL; CLAUDE.md: no tests unless requested)
No change to message-status (FEATURE B) or the bridge
No clearing of claimed_at on non-'sending' transitions (harmless stale value, only read for status='sending')
intentional_exclusions: claimed_at NOT added to DequeueMessagesAsync RETURNING projection (worker does not consume it; only the sweep reads it in SQL)
No backfill of claimed_at for pre-existing rows (legacy 'sending' rows are cleared by the ungated startup reset on first deploy; the sweep guards claimed_at IS NOT NULL)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: The periodic sending sweep has its own try/catch(NpgsqlException) that logs INV-OB-096 and is non-fatal: a transient DB error leaves the row safely 'sending' (never duplicated — pre-POST) and recovery retries next interval. OperationCanceledException (shutdown) and unexpected exceptions are intentionally NOT caught here — they propagate to ProcessQueue's typed catches (codebase policy). A non-zero reset is logged as a SystemWarn with the count.
